thread:
ashley: opened a small PR to tighten the KMS key policy and add explicit audit-log annotations. can someone take a quick look? https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4821 — need security sign-off for HSM scope before EOD tomorrow :hourglass:

sam: pinging the channel. quick Q — does this change rotation or key aliases? trying to assess impact on dedicated deployments.

ashley: good q. no rotation changes. only tightens iam/usage principals and adds `x-audit` tags for our logging pipeline. snippet:
```
- "Action": ["kms:Decrypt", "kms:Encrypt"],
- "Condition": {"StringEquals": {"aws:CalledVia": "ec2.amazonaws.com"}},
- "x-audit": {"category": "kms-use", "producer": "platform"}
```

oliver: thanks. does the `x-audit` field map to our existing audit ingestion? i want to make sure we don't drop events in the parser.

ashley: yep — parser already picks up `x-audit` if present, falls back to annotation tags. added unit test `audit_parser_test.go` in the PR.

maria: i'll do a pass now and leave comments. if everything looks good i can approve for HSM folks to sign off.

sam: i'll review after lunch, should be able to approve if tests look sane. @ashley can you add a short note in the PR description about backwards compat with older parser versions?

ashley: done — added "backwards compat: parser accepts legacy tags; new x-audit is additive" to the PR body. thanks :pray:

sec-ci-bot: CI checks passed — gosec: ok, unit-tests: 128 passed, integration: smoke passed.

maria: left two tiny nits about whitespace and one comment about error logging. none are blockers.

ashley: fixed the nits and pushed. thanks everyone :thumbsup:

sam: LGTM, approving now. i'll loop in hsm-team for final sign-off.

oliver: noted. can the hsm-team confirm that the policy changes don't require hardware key rewraps? that's an operational step we want to avoid during business hours.

ashley: no rewraps required. changes are policy-level only.

maria: approving as well. safe to merge once hsm sign-off is recorded.

ashley: great — will merge after hsm confirms. thanks all!
